content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SCTIMST Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SCTIMST Project Fellow Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Master's degree in any branch of Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/ Biochemistry with a minimum of two years' experience in Cellular reprogramming, phenotypic characterization, and molecular analysis.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Fellow position at SCTIMST is scheduled for 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in any branch of Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or Biochemistry. Additionally, a minimum of two years of experience in Cellular reprogramming, phenotypic characterization, and molecular analysis is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Fellow post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 32,560.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Project Fellow position at SCTIMST?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly with all required documents on the specified date and venue.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a walk-in interview. A written test may be conducted as a qualifying round if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala - 695011.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Fellow position is a contractual role. The duration of the contract will be as per the project requirements and institute norms.
